_comment: Position-management ruleset. Copy to ~/.cherrypick/config/manage.json and keep only what you change: the file is merged key by key over this default, and a key the default does not have is reported, not applied. Every rule carries `confidence` (0-100), reported beside its verdict. Money is gross of fees.

credit._comment: A trade opened for a net credit. capture = share of the credit kept; stop fires when the loss reaches loss_multiple_of_credit x the credit; time_exit acts at the nearest short's DTE (a winner may roll, a loser closes).

debit._comment: A trade opened for a net debit (spreads, long options, diagonals). stop at -loss_fraction, take profit at +gain_fraction; time_exit uses short_leg_dte when the trade carries shorts, long_only_dte otherwise.

legs._comment: A short leg that has given up `capture` of its premium is bought back with its wings, whatever the trade does.

expiry._comment: Physically-settled legs are closed at or inside close_by_dte; roots listed as cash-settled settle instead.

earnings_trade._comment: A trade put on to hold through an earnings report: opened min_days_before..max_days_before days before the call (1-7), its nearest short expiring no more than max_days_expiry_after days after it. Until the call its close, take-profit and roll rules wait (shown as waiting); the day after the report (the report's own day if before the open) it closes. Expiry, ex-dividend, sizing and unpriced-leg rules never wait. Disable per name with positions.<SYM>.disable ["earnings_trade"].

portfolio._comment: The account as one book: beta-weighted delta (in SPY shares, on the broker's beta), theta per calendar day, the break-even move and a stress line. Retail heuristics with no published out-of-sample evidence, hence confidence 40. Guidance is REVIEW, naming what drives it. enabled: false turns all of it off; the reading is still recorded.

theta._comment: Theta as a share of net liq per day. Above max the book sells more gamma than the band allows; under min only informs.

delta._comment: BWD band: -short_per_theta x theta to +long_per_theta x theta SPY shares. With no positive theta, +/- the BWD whose 1% move costs fallback_pct_nlv_per_1pct of net liq.

breakeven._comment: A short-gamma book whose break-even SPY move is under this multiple of SPY's implied one-day move.

concentration._comment: One underlying over max_share of the book's gross theta or gross beta-weighted delta. A position can be excused with positions.<SYM>.disable.

beta_doubt._comment: Flag a broker beta whose sign disagrees with its three-month correlation (|corr| >= min_abs_corr), or that is near zero beside a strong correlation.

stress._comment: SPY shocks the book is repriced at, each underlying moved by beta x shock, IV and time held still.

buying_power._comment: Buying power used against a ceiling that rises with VIX: [VIX under, cap] pairs, the last bound null for anything above. The common retail table. No VIX, no band.

scenarios._comment: The risk matrix (SPY moves x IV shifts in vol points for a 30-day option, time held still; with iv_shift_weighting "term" each leg's shift is scaled by sqrt(30 / DTE) so front months move most, "flat" shifts every leg alike) and the risk graph ([from, to, step] of SPY moves, now and at the nearest expiry).

hedge._comment: When portfolio.delta fires, size an XSP vertical toward a target `inset` of the band's width inside the breached edge: a credit spread (short at credit_short_delta) and a debit spread (long at debit_long_delta), each `width` points wide, at most max_units. A credit spread never takes buying power used past max_buying_power_pct of net liq; a debit spread only lowers the worst case, so it is offered past the cap and flagged. Priced at mid, with the natural price beside it; nothing is placed.

candidates._comment: Income trades from our own universe (the evening income reading), sized to the account. Structures: a short put at short_put_delta; a put or call credit spread short the first out-of-the-money strike, long at spread_long_delta, at least spread_min_credit of the width; a covered call at covered_call_delta on held shares only. Each gets the largest quantity that keeps one unit's stress loss (a spread's max loss) under per_trade_risk_pct of net liq, a short put's notional under notional_per_name_pct (by account kind), buying power under the VIX-scaled cap (else max_buying_power_pct), delta in its band, theta under its ceiling and the name under max_name_theta_share of the book's theta; the cap that stops it is named. Ranked by theta per dollar of buying power. Modelled at mid from a day-old reading: re-quote before sending.

_positions_comment: Per-underlying overrides, e.g. {"SPY": {"intent": "hedge", "disable": ["debit.stop"], "note": "portfolio hedge"}}. Rule ids: expiry, credit.take_profit, credit.stop, credit.time_exit, credit.breached, credit.close_before_earnings, debit.stop, debit.take_profit, debit.time_exit, legs.short_take_profit, roll.naked_put, roll.diagonal_short, directional.take_profit, directional.stop, ex_dividend, risk.oversize, earnings_trade, portfolio.theta, portfolio.delta, portfolio.breakeven, portfolio.concentration, portfolio.buying_power
